preMortem.scenario: Script changes its exit semantics in a follow-up story (e.g. exit 2 for warnings)
preMortem.trigger: Future PR modifies verify-koala-residue.mjs exit codes
preMortem.consequence: Gate may incorrectly PASS or BLOCK
preMortem.mitigation: Gate only treats exit 0 as PASS; any non-zero is BLOCK. Document this expectation in the gate label and code comment.

preMortem.scenario: execFileSync hangs on a misbehaving script invocation
preMortem.trigger: Script gets stuck on a git ls-files corner case
preMortem.mitigation: Set a reasonable timeout on the execFileSync call (e.g. 30s); on timeout treat as fail with a clear message.

preMortem.scenario: Operator runs story_advance to TEST and koala-residue gate fires unexpectedly because of a benign rename
preMortem.trigger: A genuine rename touches a legacy-detection file in a way classify() did not anticipate
preMortem.consequence: Story is blocked even though no real branding leak
preMortem.mitigation: Gate output prints hit lines; operator can extend script LEGACY_LOGIC_FILES or path exemptions in a follow-up story. Document the escape hatch in the BLOCK message.
